# 915 TLDR - El Paso Local News Aggregator
# https://915tldr.com

# =============================================================================
# CONTENT SIGNALS (Cloudflare Standard)
# https://developers.cloudflare.com/bots/concepts/bot/
# =============================================================================
# search=yes    → Allow search indexing
# ai-input=yes  → Allow RAG/citations (ChatGPT can reference us in answers)
# ai-train=no   → Block training data collection

User-Agent: *
Content-signal: search=yes,ai-input=yes,ai-train=no
Allow: /
Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /admin/
Disallow: /api/admin/

# =============================================================================
# SEARCH ENGINES - ALLOWED
# These are welcome to index our content for search results
# =============================================================================

# Google Search
User-agent: Googlebot
Allow: /

# Google Images
User-agent: Googlebot-Image
Allow: /

# Bing / Microsoft
User-agent: Bingbot
Allow: /

# DuckDuckGo
User-agent: DuckDuckBot
Allow: /

# Yahoo (uses Bing)
User-agent: Slurp
Allow: /

# Brave Search
User-agent: BraveSearch
Allow: /

# Yandex
User-agent: YandexBot
Allow: /

# Baidu
User-agent: Baiduspider
Allow: /

# Qwant
User-agent: Qwantify
Allow: /

# Mojeek
User-agent: MojeekBot
Allow: /

# =============================================================================
# AI TRAINING BOTS - BLOCKED
# These crawl content to train LLMs. We don't consent to training.
# =============================================================================

# OpenAI - ChatGPT training
User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /

# Anthropic - Claude training
User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: anthropic-ai
Disallow: /

# Common Crawl - Dataset for AI training
User-agent: CCBot
Disallow: /

# Meta/Facebook - Llama training
User-agent: meta-externalagent
Disallow: /

User-agent: FacebookBot
Disallow: /

# Google - AI training (separate from search)
User-agent: Google-Extended
Disallow: /

User-agent: GoogleOther
Disallow: /

User-agent: Google-CloudVertexBot
Disallow: /

# Apple - AI training
User-agent: Applebot-Extended
Disallow: /

# Amazon - Alexa/AI training
User-agent: Amazonbot
Disallow: /

# ByteDance - TikTok/AI
User-agent: Bytespider
Disallow: /

Disallow: /

# Huawei
User-agent: PetalBot
Disallow: /

# Cohere
User-agent: cohere-ai
Disallow: /

# AI21 Labs
User-agent: AI2Bot
Disallow: /

# =============================================================================
# AI ASSISTANTS / RAG - ALLOWED
# These use real-time retrieval to cite sources. We WANT this traffic.
# =============================================================================

# ChatGPT browsing/plugins (different from GPTBot training)
User-agent: ChatGPT-User
Allow: /

# DuckDuckGo AI assistant
User-agent: DuckAssistBot
Allow: /

# Perplexity - search index + user-triggered fetches for cited answers
# (allowed 2026-10-02: ai-input=yes; training remains opted out via ai-train=no)
User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Perplexity-User
Allow: /
